page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with one thread per core. The memory configuration consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of this instance is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression show poor to weak performance. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all positioning in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests, including both cached small-block and uncached large-block reads and writes, consistently register average performance.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for general-purpose workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution rather than high single-core speeds. It achieves average throughput in static web serving (9.98 GB/sec) and Redis SET operations (11.35 million operations/sec). The hardware profile offers moderate resource density for multi-threaded applications, database operations, and lightweight LLM inference, though it presents a performance tradeoff for single-threaded or storage-heavy tasks due to the lack of local SSDs and lower single-core metrics.
